entities.summary: The Kalachuris of Tripuri, also known the Kalachuris of Chedi and Kalachuris of Dahala, who ruled Dahala mandala (Baghelkhand) during 7th to 13th centuries. They are also known as the Later Kalachuris to distinguish them from their earlier namesakes, especially the Kalachuris of Mahishmati. Their core territory lay in the Baghelkhand region, historically known as Dahala-mandala, which formed a part of the wider Chedi region. Their capital was located at Tripuri.
